articles.title: SiriusPoint: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
articles.summary: PEMBROKE, Bermuda (AP) — SiriusPoint Ltd. (SPNT) on Wednesday reported profit of $244 million in its fourth quarter. On a per-share basis, the Pembroke, Bermuda-based company said it had net income of $1.97. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring gains, were 70 cents per share.
